title: Funny AI Videos: 8 Clips and the Prompts Behind Them
summary: 8 funny AI videos made in Flick with the prompt behind each: a cat pushing milk off a table, a goat crashing a yoga class, gossiping lemons. Make your own.
body_markdown:
### How do I make a funny AI video?


Make a still image that sets up the joke, then animate it with an image to video model and a prompt that describes the setup, the one thing that goes wrong and the reaction at the end, with a static camera.


### What are some funny AI video ideas?


Good funny AI video ideas include an animal that fails at a simple plan, such as a beagle stealing a sausage at dinner, a calm character in a silly situation, such as a pug running a job interview, and fruit acting out a soap opera.


### What should a funny AI video prompt include?


A funny AI video prompt should name who is in the scene, what they are doing, the one thing that goes wrong, the reaction at the end, the tone in plain words such as deadpan comedy, and a static camera with everyone in frame.


### Can I make a funny AI video of my pet?


Yes. Upload a photo of your pet as the start frame, or use it as a reference for a new still, then describe a short funny moment such as your dog getting stuck with a stick and animate it.


### Why does my AI video not look funny?


An AI video usually misses the joke when the prompt describes a mood instead of events, so write the action beat by beat, end on a reaction, and keep the camera still so the timing is easy to follow.


### Is it free to make funny AI videos?


Yes, you can start free: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, enough to animate a still into a short funny clip with Auto.


### Can I add sound to a funny AI video?


Yes. Auto can make the clip with sound, and you can also generate music or a voice line in Flick and lay it over the clip, which helps a punchline land.
